title: U.S. House · Ohio's 1st District
area: Includes most of Cincinnati and Hamilton County

context.text: Ohio redrew its congressional map ahead of 2026 under a new Ohio Redistricting Commission plan. The Cook Political Report rates the 1st District R+1.

positions.summary: In an April 2026 statement he says he voted for an Iran War Powers Resolution and that the President should come to Congress for help; he supported only targeted strikes.
positions.quote: It's time to be done in Iran, and I hope my vote in favor of the War Powers Resolution sends that message.

positions.summary: In a February 2023 statement on joining the House Pro-Choice Caucus, he says he will work to combat attacks on abortion access and restore reproductive freedoms.
positions.quote: I will work with the House Pro-Choice Caucus to combat these attacks and restore these freedoms.

positions.summary: In a July 2026 statement he says he voted against a bill including parts of the SAVE America Act, which he says would prevent millions of Americans from voting.
positions.quote: The bill includes aspects of Trump's voter suppression bill the "SAVE America Act," which will prevent tens of millions of Americans from voting.

positions.summary: In a January 2026 statement he calls on ICE to immediately withdraw from Minneapolis.
positions.quote: ICE should immediately withdraw from Minneapolis before more innocent Americans are hurt.

positions.summary: In a September 2026 release he announced a bill funded by a Billionaire Income Tax Act that sets a minimum 20 percent tax rate for households worth over $100 million.
positions.quote: Implement a Billionaire Income Tax Act to ensure households worth over $100 million pay at least a 20 percent tax rate on their full income, including unrealized gains.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce (Environment; Health; Communications and Technology subcommittees) in the 119th Congress (2025-2026).

Said on July 19, 2024 that President Joe Biden should withdraw from the 2024 Democratic presidential race, saying 'It is time for President Biden to step aside and allow us to nominate a new leader who can reliably and consistently make the case against Donald Trump and make the case for the future of America.'

candidates.name: Eric Conroy

priorities.text: Says national security and border security must be restored, supporting 'strong border enforcement, modernizing our immigration system, and ensuring that federal law is consistently upheld.'
priorities.quote: National security and border security must be restored. A safe nation is the foundation for prosperity.

priorities.text: Calls for fiscal responsibility, citing federal spending as a driver of inflation, and says he will 'advocate for responsible budgeting, reducing waste, and policies that promote economic growth and job creation.'
Supports energy independence and expanding domestic energy production and American manufacturing.

positions.summary: Campaign site says he supports legislation reserving women's sports by sex, which would bar transgender women and girls.
positions.quote: Eric Conroy supports legislation to ensure women’s sports are reserved for biological females, protecting fairness and equal opportunity.

positions.summary: Campaign site says he supports continued military aid to Israel.
positions.quote: He supports continued military aid to Israel

statements.quote: He supports critical funding for law enforcement and equipping officers with the necessary resources and training to serve safely and effectively.
statements.context: On his campaign website (third-person issue page)

statements.quote: and he supports the swift deportation of violent illegal immigrant criminals.
statements.context: On his campaign website (third-person issue page)

candidates.researchNotes: Campaign issue pages reviewed; other pages (economy, education, Social Security) do not map to the guide's issues.

priorities.text: Supports 'responsible spending reforms' to address inflation and make homeownership more attainable, under the message 'Make America Affordable Again.'
Supports ending U.S. involvement in foreign wars and reducing the number of U.S. military bases abroad.
Supports an 'Ellis Island-style' immigration policy that eases entry and provides a path to permanent residency, and opposes militarized border enforcement.

positions.summary: Supports easier legal immigration and opposes militarized immigration enforcement; says he would abolish ICE.
positions.quote: He supports eliminating the militarization of border security and immigration enforcement, believing that force should not be used against individuals who are not violent. Abolish ICE and replace it with nothing.
